digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criteria routing and kind scoping
propositions: G7 routing entry default_posture must change from advisory to blocking with block_threshold 0.85 to prevent false negatives while maintaining zero clearly-incorrect findings across 348 historical G7 findings at priority >= 0.85

G7 blocking must accept both contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor kinds via the existing plan-v4 divergence grading, where both hard-floor impact at 0.85 but incomplete_enumeration contributes only 0.55 and cannot reach the blocking threshold

Rubric must codify four rules: abstain-with-coverage on unresolvable parents (never emit a finding), closed-parent-final-state checking with sibling handoff scope exclusion, one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause dedup pattern, and floor-kind guidance to prevent cosmetic mismatches from auto-blocking

Plan-review Pass-3 blocking is determined solely by default_posture=='blocking' plus block_threshold comparison (criteria/model.py threshold_for, gate='plan_review'); no per-grade gating logic is added to decide.py

Pinned test assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must all reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking') to lock the routing configuration and blocking-set membership

New test_g7_blocking.py must verify via the real orchestrator Pass-3 wrapper with real impact_plan that contradicts_reality and omits_required_site findings block at priority >= 0.85, incomplete_enumeration stays advisory at 0.55, and all four rubric rules are present
